lines: London still plays almost every down, with 92% of snaps over his last 3 games and 90% for the season. His target share slipped to 24% from 28%.
Production has dipped lately: 10.2 PPR points per game over the last 3, against 13.8 for the season. He is catching 4.0 per game, down from 5.0.
ATL has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said London cleared the concussion evaluation and has no known lingering issue heading into the bye.
